newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Sec shares ask-only in early Tokyo trading.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Sec shares ask-only in early Tokyo trading.

text.p: Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd were ask-only in Tokyo early on Friday following last night's announcement by the company that two of its directors had been involved in an "apparently irregular" deal with a corporate client, brokers said.
As of 0002 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 1,550 yen, compared with its Thursday's close of 1,580.
Nomura's shares later traded 50 yen lower at 1,530 yen at 0044 GMT. Volume was 3.319 million shares, the second heaviest on the bourse this morning.
The Nomura news weighed on the entire market, brokers said.
"Bearish sentiment carried over from yesterday and it was worsened a little by Nomura's news," said a trader at a foreign securities house.

Nomura vice president Atsushi Saito said on Thursday that Japan's securities watchdog was investigating stock transactions which he said the two directors made through the client's account several times without the client's approval.
